applies_why: The judge text issues UNDERDETERMINED because the Acts 2:30 wording does not name whose body is the channel, which is the kind of single-verse non-statement K-S2 governs.
quote: the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. When one verse's words carry two meanings at once, both stand; the verse is not open.
room: a single verse does not state a link or its contrary — I weighed using that non-statement as a reason for UNDERDETERMINED, versus K-S2's reading that such non-statement is never grounds and both meanings stand.
why: The judge's UNDERDETERMINED rests on the alleged absence of a named channel in the verse, which is exactly a single verse's non-statement used as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED.
